## Response identity

Every response includes the request/build contract headers defined by the machine-readable contract:

- `x-request-id` (requestId)
- `x-edatime-build` (buildVersion)
- `x-edatime-build-sha` (buildCommit)
- `x-edatime-build-profile` (buildProfile)
- `x-edatime-contract` (contractVersion)

Caller request IDs must follow this policy: A caller-supplied ID is accepted only when it is 1-128 ASCII letters, digits, dot, underscore, or hyphen; otherwise the server replaces it.

## Errors

Errors use `application/json` and require these fields: `error`, `message`, `kind`, `code`, `correlation_id`, `request_id`.

The JSON snapshot at `GET /api/v1/metrics` is intended for local diagnostics. `GET /api/v1/metrics/prometheus` exposes the same bounded, low-cardinality operational signals for scraping. Handler latency ends when a response is created; body latency ends when the response stream completes or is abandoned.
